name: Pharma Study Verse Tools Registry
purpose: A practical toolbox for pharmacy learning, calculations, research, career preparation, manufacturing and pharmaceutical marketing.
principles: Calculators show formula, substituted values, intermediate steps, final answer and unit checks.
Educational calculators do not replace official standards, validated software, institutional SOPs or professional judgment.
Clinical or patient-specific calculations must remain clearly labelled educational and must not be presented as treatment instructions.
Career tools support preparation and drafting; they do not guarantee employment or selection.
Dictionary definitions should be linked to approved or reviewed content where possible.

categories.label: Calculators

categories.label: Academic Helpers
categories.description: Study planning, unit conversion, grade and revision utilities.

calculator_quality.rounding: Show enough precision for learning and make rounding explicit.
calculator_quality.auditability: Inputs and calculation steps should remain visible so a student can reproduce the result manually.
